title: Fraunhofer Institute for Manufacturing Technology and Advanced Materials IFAM
content: Aerogel Research Institute. Fraunhofer Institute for Manufacturing Technology and Advanced Materials IFAM is a research institute focused on functional materials, polymer systems, and verification of performance and service life. These capabilities make it relevant for aerogel composites, materials characterization, and application-focused R&D support.
